name: SOC 2 Common Criteria (Security)
description: The security Trust Services Criteria every SOC 2 report covers. Auditors expect evidence that each control operated consistently across the review period, not just that it exists today.

items.note: CC6.2 / CC6.3 — registration and removal of access.
CC7.3 / CC7.4 — incident evaluation and response.
A1.2 — recovery, where availability is in scope.
CC6.7 — protection of data in transit and at rest.
CC2.2 — internal communication of security responsibilities.
